svg.title: Row-wise embedding lookup: key data flow across four ranks
svg.desc: Each rank starts with one feature-major tensor. Bucketize produces destination-rank-major send segments. AllToAll places each source segment at its owner rank. A final permutation groups keys by feature. Orange means Table A, cyan means Table B. Digits are owner ranks, not actual key IDs. All 40 keys are conserved. The closing overview fills all four layouts at once.
svg.text: Cell number = owner rank, not key ID
